svg.title: Alice and Benjamin: interior contract curve

cc:Work.dc:title: Alice and Benjamin: interior contract curve
cc:Work.dc:description: Every interior efficient allocation has x_2^A=1 and x_2^B=2. The allocation of good 1 varies strictly between 0 and 5.
